official.deadline_note: Deadlines are the institute's standing annual windows rather than scheme-specific: Autumn (M.Tech., M.B.A., M.Des., and Ph.D.) 20 March - 15 April every year; Spring Ph.D. 1 September - 31 October every year.
official.application_cycle: Standing annual intake windows: Autumn 20 March - 15 April (M.Tech., M.B.A., M.Des., Ph.D.); Spring Ph.D. 1 September - 31 October. As of 10 October 2026 the Spring Ph.D. window is the open one; the next autumn window opens 20 March 2027.
official.status_note: The OIR how-to-apply page publishes standing yearly deadlines; as of 10 October 2026 the Spring Ph.D. window (1 September - 31 October) is open. The autumn 2026-27-I window ran 19 March - 15 April 2026, with foreign-national email submissions accepted up to 30 April 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Institute Fellowship is a monthly stipend only; published foreign-national charges still apply. OIR fee table: Ph.D (SAARC) USD250 + INR 17495; Ph.D (Non-SAARC) USD500 + INR 17495; M.Tech (SAARC) USD500 + INR 17495; M.Tech (Non-SAARC) USD750 + INR 17495; MBA (SAARC) USD2000 + INR 17495; MBA (Non-SAARC) USD4000 + INR 17495 (tuition fee + hostel fee charges).
benefits: IIT Kanpur offers all foreign degree students a monthly fellowship at par with Indian students

Institute Assistantship rate for regular non-sponsored students: M.Tech students receive Rs.12,400/- per month; Ph.D. students receive Rs.37,000/- per month for the first two years, raised to Rs.42,000/- per month thereafter
Application fee is waived for candidates in the Foreign National category
Requirement of GATE qualification is waived for candidates in the Foreign National category
Access to OIR support including visa and FRRO registration guidance for foreign students
eligibility: Candidates who are NOT citizens of India (by birth or naturalized) and/or are OCI/PIO card holders are treated as foreign nationals
Only those students who do not receive any other funding will be eligible for the Institute Fellowship
Admitted to an M.Tech, M.Des, MS (By Research), MBA or Ph.D. programme as a foreign degree student
requirements: It is mandatory for all foreign students intending to pursue higher education in India to complete their registration on the Study in India (SII) portal; this registration is linked to issuance of their study visa
Apply online through the IIT Kanpur PG admission portal during the relevant intake window
Final selection of shortlisted foreign-national candidates is based on interviews through video conferencing
documents: Mark/Grade sheet of Qualifying Degree (as a single PDF file)
selection_criteria: The competent committees of the departments are the ultimate decision makers in student admissions
Foreign-national shortlisted candidates are selected on the basis of interviews conducted through video conferencing
coverage: Monthly fellowship stipend at par with Indian students: Rs.12,400/- per month for M.Tech students and Rs.37,000/- per month for Ph.D. students for the first two years, raised to Rs.42,000/- per month thereafter
The fellowship does not cover tuition or hostel charges, which remain payable as published for the foreign-national category
application_method: For direct IIT Kanpur admission, register and apply online through the PG admission portal when the intake window is open
Where the portal route is unavailable for foreign nationals, send the complete application with required testimonials to admissions_ir@iitk.ac.in (cc admissiondesk@iitk.ac.in)
Candidates under Government of India schemes (ICCR, Study in India, ASEAN DIA, India-Bhutan) apply through those schemes' own portals instead
official.application_route: Apply through the IIT Kanpur PG admissions online portal during the intake window; foreign-national candidates without portal access email the application to admissions_ir@iitk.ac.in
official.citizenship_residency: Open to foreign nationals only: candidates who are not citizens of India by birth or naturalisation and/or are OCI/PIO card holders
official.international_eligibility: This fellowship exists exclusively for international students; it is the foreign-national counterpart of the Institute Assistantship given to Indian students
official.duration: Tied to the admitted programme: assistantships are awarded semester-to-semester, up to two years for M.Tech. students and up to a maximum of five years for Ph.D. students
official.description: IIT Kanpur offers all foreign degree students a monthly fellowship at par with Indian students; only those students who do not receive any other funding are eligible for the Institute Fellowship.
official.program_type: Institute-funded monthly fellowship for admitted foreign degree students

verification.notes: The OIR scholarship and how-to-apply pages publish the scheme wording and rules but no amount; the amount comes from IIT Kanpur's own department financial-aid pages stating the Institute Assistantship rates (M.Tech Rs.12,400/month; Ph.D. Rs.37,000/month for two years, then Rs.42,000/month) that the OIR page says the foreign Institute Fellowship matches ('at par with Indian students').

applicant_utility.summary: The Institute Fellowship is IIT Kanpur's fallback monthly stipend for foreign nationals admitted to an M.Tech, M.Des, MS (By Research), MBA or Ph.D. programme who hold no other funding: it pays the same rate Indian students get (Rs.12,400/month at M.Tech level; Rs.37,000/month in a Ph.D.'s first two years, Rs.42,000/month after), but the published foreign-national tuition and hostel fees are still paid out of pocket. There is no separate fellowship application - your real submission is the PG admissions application, and the shortlisted-stage video-conference interview effectively decides the outcome. If you are eligible for ICCR, Study in India, AARDO, ASEAN DIA or the India-Bhutan scheme, apply to those instead, because they can waive tuition and add airfare that this fellowship never provides.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Foreign nationals already targeting an IIT Kanpur M.Tech/M.Des/MS(R)/MBA/Ph.D. seat who have no external funding and need a reliable monthly stipend rather than a fee waiver.
application_readiness_checklist: Complete Study in India (SII) portal registration before applying - it is mandatory and tied to study-visa issuance
Prepare the eight-document set in advance, with the mark/grade sheet of the qualifying degree merged into a single PDF
Diarise the standing windows: 1 September - 31 October for Spring Ph.D., 20 March - 15 April for Autumn M.Tech/MBA/M.Des/Ph.D.
Test your video-conferencing setup early; shortlisted foreign nationals are interviewed by video
First check whether an external scheme (ICCR, SII, AARDO, ASEAN DIA, India-Bhutan) pays more and apply there if eligible - the Institute Fellowship excludes anyone with other funding
If the portal is inaccessible for foreign nationals, email admissions_ir@iitk.ac.in (cc admissiondesk@iitk.ac.in) with the full application
common_rejection_risks: Holding, or later accepting, any other scholarship or funding, which voids Institute Fellowship eligibility by the stated rule
Missing the video-conference interview arranged for shortlisted foreign-national candidates
Uploading mark/grade sheets as separate files instead of the required single PDF, causing processing delays
Late SII portal registration that blocks the study visa and therefore the admission
Applying after the portal shuts in the autumn cycle (mid-April) without using the email route in time
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition plus hostel charges published for foreign nationals (USD 250-4,000 plus INR 17,495 depending on programme and SAARC status) remain payable, along with airfare, insurance, and first-month living costs in Kanpur.
document_audit: Qualifying degree certificate must be original or provisional - unofficial printouts stall the file
Mark/grade sheet must be one single PDF, not a set of scans
NOC is needed only for sponsored, part-time or external candidates; sending one needlessly can confuse categorization
GATE score card is optional but helps; it is not required for foreign nationals
alerts: The stipend parity is financial only - Indian-student fee waivers do not carry over to foreign nationals, so budget tuition separately
Winning any external funding (including a departmental assistantship from another country) makes you ineligible for this fellowship
The autumn 2026 window closed on 15 April 2026 (email route to 30 April 2026); the next autumn window opens 20 March 2027
The currently open Spring Ph.D. window closes 31 October 2026
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register and submit on the PG admissions portal (or by email to admissions_ir@iitk.ac.in when the portal route is unavailable), after which shortlisted foreign nationals are interviewed by video conference and the department committee decides.
